summary.text: Scott Odenbach is a Republican state representative from District 31 who took office in January 2021, serves as House majority leader and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner and attorney.

paragraphs.text: Scott Odenbach was born in Eureka, South Dakota, in 1972.
He received a bachelor's degree from South Dakota State University in 1995 and a J.D. from the University of South Dakota School of Law in 2001.
As of May 2025, he owned Odenbach Law Office and was the managing broker of the real estate firm Liberty Tree Properties.
Odenbach served on the Spearfish School Board from 2017 to 2020 and was elected to the state House in 2020.
House Republicans elected him majority leader effective January 14, 2025.
